title: Siege of Querétaro
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Querétaro", at revision 1370744664, opens: "The siege of Querétaro was the culminating battle of the Second French intervention in Mexico and the Second Mexican Empire. It took place between Republican and Imperial armies from 6 March to 15 May 1867." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3486010, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1867 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
